summary: Regression test of the defensive refactor (server.py -> models.py + moderation.py + helpers.py; profile.tsx -> EditProfileModal/PrefsModal/ProfessionModal + socials.ts + photoCache.ts). Backend: 14/14 pytest regression tests PASS (100%) — signup, login, anonymous, me, categories, professions, feuds list, hype feed, vote, comment (clean + blocked-word 'vaffanculo' returns 400), stories feed, story create, support submit. Moderation module still enforces BLOCKED_WORDS correctly. Frontend: found 1 REGRESSION (fixed) — profile.tsx imported only `validateNickname` from src/utils/nickname but the refactored `openProfileEdit` (line 308) and save handler (line 547) still call `sanitizeNicknameInput` which was NOT imported, producing a runtime red-screen 'sanitizeNicknameInput is not defined' the moment the user tapped MODIFICA PROFILO. Added `sanitizeNicknameInput` to the import list in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx line 17. After the fix all three extracted modals open, render their extracted content (nickname/name/photos/bio/socials fields for Edit; 9 category chips for Prefs; 25 profession options for Profession) and close cleanly via their X buttons with no crashes. No other refactor breakage detected.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED during test: `sanitizeNicknameInput` was used at lines 308 and 547 but not imported (only `validateNickname` was imported from @/src/utils/nickname). Tapping MODIFICA PROFILO threw a red-screen 'sanitizeNicknameInput is not defined' via openProfileEdit. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx:17 (added sanitizeNicknameInput to the import).

action_items: No further action needed — the missing `sanitizeNicknameInput` import in profile.tsx line 17 has been added by the testing agent and profile edit flow is verified working end-to-end.
Double-check whether any OTHER symbol was dropped from imports during the profile refactor (a quick eslint no-undef sweep on profile.tsx would surface anything similar).
Consider carrying over the stale pointerEvents deprecation fix from iteration 61 backlog (not caused by this refactor).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still opens with `from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, EmailStr` (line 20) even though every Pydantic body was moved to models.py — the direct pydantic import is only kept for one or two remaining inline schemas; if none remain the top-level import can be dropped.

helpers.py exports lowercase names (now_utc, iso_utc, new_id, hash_password, verify_password, strip_data_url, hashtag_norm, extract_subject_from_title, is_stance_party, clean_subject, HASHTAG_STOPWORDS) and server.py re-aliases most of them with underscore prefixes (`iso_utc as _iso_utc`). Consider standardising: either export underscore names from helpers.py directly or drop the aliases in server.py — the mixed convention is a source of future drift like the one we just hit in profile.tsx.

moderation.py imports `emergentintegrations.llm.chat` lazily inside the function — good — but the module-level `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` will log under 'moderation' whereas server.py logs under 'server'. Consider passing/using the same logger name so the JSON audit trail stays cohesive.

profile.tsx after refactor is still 1439 lines with plenty of state (photos, socials, prefs) that could be lifted into a `useProfileState` hook to bring the file below the 1000-line target the refactor implicitly aimed for.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 3 extracted modals open + close correctly after the import fix)

seed_data_creation: Used the pre-verified seed user chat_a@test.it (see /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Ephemeral signups (TEST_regress_<hex>@test.it) are created by the signup test but land in `requires_verification` state (no email delivery in this env) — DB rows exist but are harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The only refactor regression was the missing `sanitizeNicknameInput` import in profile.tsx (fixed). Backend regression suite `test_refactor_regression.py` covers signup/login/anonymous/me/categories/professions/feuds/hype/vote/comment (clean + blocked)/stories/support and can be reused as a smoke test for future backend refactors. Endpoints return `{key: [...]}` dicts for categories/professions/feuds/hype (not raw lists) — the suite uses a `_unwrap` helper to handle either shape. auth/login+signup returns `{token, user}` where `user.user_id` (NOT `user.id`) is the canonical id — /api/auth/me returns `{user: {...}}` with the same key. Fresh signups return `{requires_verification: true, email, message}` and no token, so tests must fall back to the seed user for authenticated calls.
rca_of_issue: PRIMARY BUG (fixed): During the profile.tsx refactor the main agent moved photo/socials/bio/nickname UI into <EditProfileModal>, which correctly imports `sanitizeNicknameInput`. However, TWO call sites in the parent (`openProfileEdit` at line 308 and the save handler at line 547) still call the function directly, and the parent's import statement (line 17) was NOT updated to keep it. Result: as soon as the user taps the MODIFICA PROFILO button, JS throws `ReferenceError: sanitizeNicknameInput is not defined`, React Native shows the red screen and the modal never mounts. Mitigation applied: added `sanitizeNicknameInput` back to the import from `@/src/utils/nickname` — no logic change required. RE-TEST post-fix: all three modals open successfully (edit modal shows nickname/name/photos/bio/socials; prefs modal shows 9 category chips; profession modal shows 25 options) and close cleanly via their X buttons with zero console errors.
